Alignment

Proposed joint research themes with AOF

  1. Sustainable finance & ESG in ASEAN emerging markets — Thailand–Vietnam comparative studies
  2. Corporate governance & earnings quality — evidence from SET and Vietnamese listed firms
  3. Digital finance — CBDC, crypto-asset accounting and fintech adoption
  4. Supply-chain finance & logistics — Thailand’s EEC and Thai–Vietnam trade corridors
  5. English for finance & accounting — corpus-based ESP and business communication

Research agenda for Thailand’s Eastern Economic Corridor (EEC)

  1. Smart port & multimodal logistics — cyber-resilience, low-emission freight and rail–port links for Laem Chabang Phase 3 and U-Tapao
  2. Workforce for S-curve industries — leadership, HRM and business English for automotive, aerospace and foreign-invested firms (EEC Model)
  3. Wellness & destination services — Thai-massage and wellness tourism, cruise ports and community-based tourism along Pattaya–Rayong
  4. BCG & ESG-ready investment — climate-risk disclosure, green supply chains and low-burning agricultural value chains
  5. Gaps to build — comprehensive healthcare management and the economics of AI / data-centre investment

Policy frame: EEC target clusters (medical, digital, next-generation automotive, BCG, services) and flagship projects — eeco.or.th, accessed Sep 2026. Each article is counted in one dimension.

Articles in journals discontinued from Scopus

The Overview counts every article whose journal has an SJR quartile in the publication year. This page lists all articles in titles discontinued by Scopus, with the reason and final covered issue from the Scopus Source List (Aug 2026). “Not covered” = published after the final covered issue — these are counted as discontinued and excluded from the AOF alignment. Special-issue numbering marked “likely” should be verified in Scopus.

Research domains were classified from article titles and journal names. “Former staff” = published authors not listed in the current directory.
